name: NCAA D-I Northeast Regional Cross Country Championships
where: Farmingdale, NY · host Hofstra · Bethpage State Park
headline: NCAA D-I Northeast Regional Cross Country Championships
summary: Final: No. 13 Syracuse won the men’s title with 49 points over No. 11 Harvard (72), and host Hofstra’s Fredrick Kipkosgei won the race in 30:11.0. No. 30 Boston College edged No. 27 Providence 51 to 58 in the women’s race, with Syracuse third (77) and Syracuse’s Keira Rogan the winner in 19:46.9.
